archiveDuration.title:
存储到期后，自动归档保存的天数，0表示不归档保存。归档天数取值范围：
V1：1~365天。仅按指标写入量支持。
V2：1~3650天（3650表示永久保存）。
archiveDuration.description: The number of days to store archived data after the storage duration expires. A value of 0 disables archiving. For V1 instances, the valid values are 1 to 365. This is supported only for the pay-by-data-write billing method. For V2 instances, the valid values are 1 to 3650. A value of 3650 indicates permanent storage.

paymentType.title:
